description: The bar chart illustrates the results of an ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset, specifically measuring the "Recall@10" metric across different model configurations. The horizontal axis displays the categorical configurations, ordered from left to right as "Ours", "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking", with the text labels slightly rotated. The vertical axis represents the metric value on a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 0.4, featuring tick marks and corresponding horizontal grid lines at regular intervals of 0.1. There are four vertical bars representing the data. The first bar, labeled "Ours", is visually emphasized in orange and is the tallest in the chart, reaching an approximate value of 0.35. The subsequent three bars are all colored blue. The "- critiquing" bar has an approximate value of 0.29, the "- scoring" bar is the shortest at roughly 0.17, and the "- ranking" bar has a value of approximately 0.23. The bars are not sorted by height, but rather present the primary model followed by its three ablated variations.
